title: AWS Lambda Web Function with private VPC egress
description: Run a Lambda Web Function that reaches private resources in your VPC through a Lambda network connector

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys a Node.js HTTP server as an AWS Lambda Web Function with private egress into your VPC. An AWS::Serverless::NetworkConnector creates network interfaces in two of your subnets, and the function's revision references the connector's version-qualified ARN, so outbound calls go through your VPC.
The endpoint uses IamAuth, so only SigV4-signed requests reach the code. A revision that uses a network connector supports only HomeRegion endpoints.
The sample app can call an optional private URL, INTERNAL_TARGET_URL, and shows whether it was reachable through the VPC.
